name: web-blue-travel-landing-explore-places-and-faq
title: Travel Landing: Popular Places and FAQ
whatItIs: A cropped landing page: feature columns for flights, hotels and trips, an 'Explore Popular Place' carousel of destination photo cards with scalloped discount tags, and a FAQ accordion with 'Questions' circled in a hand-drawn oval.
whatItMeans: Lavender panels and blue pills keep a photo-heavy page airy, and the circled word adds a human, handmade touch.
techniques: Hand-drawn oval around one heading word
Alternating white and lavender section backgrounds
Destination cards with price and pill CTA
Accordion FAQ with blue plus/minus toggles
bestFor: Sections that need both browsing and reassurance

vocabulary.definition: A heading word ringed by a sketchy ellipse.
A label with wavy or torn edges.
A list of items that expand and collapse.
